description: Icons, text, buttons and a count around an input or textarea, in one field: the focus ring closes in on the whole group, the count rolls as you type and a send button pops in with the first character.
moves: The focus ring belongs to the group: it starts out wide and closes onto the field on a spring.
The count rolls its digits up or down as the text grows and shrinks.
Anything marked `data-show="filled"`, like a send button, pops in with the first character and shrinks away when the field is empty.
Buttons in the group sink and spring back.
keyboard: Moves between the field and the buttons in the group; each is its own tab stop.

propDocs.InputGroupAddon.align: Where the addon sits: `"inline-start"` (before the input, the default), `"inline-end"` (after it), `"block-start"` (above a textarea) or `"block-end"` (below it).
propDocs.InputGroupCount.show: `"used"` shows how many characters the field holds (with `/maxLength` when it has one); `"left"` shows how many are left under its `maxLength`.
propDocs.InputGroupButton.size: `"xs"` (24px, the default), `"sm"` (28px), `"icon-xs"` or `"icon-sm"` for a square icon button.
propDocs.InputGroupButton.variant: Which Button look to use. Ghost by default, so it sits quietly inside the field.
